goal: Hold what a survivor is carrying: stacks of items with a per-stack maximum and a total carry limit. Adding past the limit fails rather than silently dropping items, because a player who cannot tell the difference will assume the game lost their salvage.
acceptance_criteria: A ModuleScript at src/server/Inventory.luau returns a table with Add, Remove, Count and Clear functions, all annotated.
An exported type describes a stack: its item id and its quantity.
Add refuses and changes nothing when the carry limit would be exceeded, and returns how many were actually added.
Remove refuses to take more of an item than the player holds, and drops a stack that reaches zero.
Every file begins with --!strict and the whole project passes scripts/verify.ps1.
notes: Keep it small: one module, under 120 lines. A short answer is a correct answer more often.
Return only the files you create. Do not return a file you are not changing.
